items.exampleEn: The story is not told in a linear way; it jumps between past and present.

items.exampleEn: This laptop is robust enough to survive a fall.
items.exampleZh: 這台筆電夠堅固，摔一下也不會壞。

items.exampleEn: She found a battered suitcase in her grandmother's old house.
items.exampleZh: 她在奶奶的老房子裡找到一個破舊的行李箱。

items.exampleEn: Success can be elusive in the music business.

The simplicity of the design makes the machine easy to use.

items.exampleEn: It was startling to see snow in April.
items.exampleZh: 四月看到下雪，真令人吃驚。

items.exampleZh: 把蛋和糖攪拌到滑順、呈奶油狀。

options: It belongs to his old boss

items.sentenceEn: Business is usually slack in the weeks after the holidays.
items.sentenceZh: 假期過後的那幾個星期，生意通常比較清淡。

items.sentenceEn: The survey produced some startling results about sleep.
items.sentenceZh: 這份調查得出了一些關於睡眠的驚人結果。

items.stemEn: This old bridge looks weak, but it is actually very ____.
items.stemZh: 這座舊橋看起來不太牢固，但其實非常堅固。

items.stemEn: The beauty of this design lies in its ____.
items.stemZh: 這個設計的美，就在於它的簡潔。

items.passageEn: For years, a rare owl in our local forest proved elusive. Many bird lovers had searched for it, but nobody had taken a clear photo. Last winter, a retired teacher named Mr. Wu decided to try. He carried only a battered old camera and a notebook, and he walked the same straight path through the forest every morning, despite the ceaseless winter rain. In his notebook, he recorded every walk in strict linear order, with the time and weather. His friends laughed at the simplicity of his plan. However, after six weeks, he got a startling photo of the owl sitting on a fence just a few meters away. Experts say the forest's robust bird population makes such moments possible.
items.passageZh: 多年來，我們當地森林裡的一種稀有貓頭鷹一直很難找到。許多賞鳥人士都找過牠，但沒有人拍到清楚的照片。去年冬天，一位名叫吳先生的退休老師決定試試看。他只帶了一台破舊的老相機和一本筆記本，每天早上冒著下個不停的冬雨，走同一條筆直的小路穿過森林。他在筆記本裡嚴格依時間順序記下每次散步，連同時間和天氣。朋友們笑他的計畫太簡單。不過，六週之後，他拍到一張驚人的照片：那隻貓頭鷹就停在幾公尺外的籬笆上。專家說，這片森林的鳥類族群數量穩健，才可能出現這樣的時刻。

questions.questionZh: 吳先生用的是什麼方法？
options: 每天早上都走同一條路線
他的朋友們也一起加入找鳥
拍到貓頭鷹停在籬笆上

items.promptZh: 我很喜歡這間公寓設計上的簡潔。
referenceEn: I really like the simplicity of this apartment's design.
I love the simplicity of the design of this apartment.
rubricZh: simplicity 是名詞，表示「簡單、簡潔」（例如 the simplicity of the design 等）
「很喜歡」可寫，例如 really like、love、like…a lot 等

items.promptZh: 那隻罕見的鳥非常難以捉摸，攝影師等了三天才拍到牠。
referenceEn: The rare bird was very elusive; the photographer waited three days to get a picture of it.
The rare bird proved so elusive that the photographer waited three days before getting a photo of it.
rubricZh: 「難以捉摸」用 elusive（例如 was very elusive、proved elusive 等）
「等了三天才拍到」可寫，例如 waited three days to get a picture 等
說的是已發生的事，時態配合內容（例如 was、waited 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似不自然：walked the same linear path through the forest——linear path 不是描述林間小路的道地搭配（多說 the same straight path／the same route），也沒示範 linear 的本課義（線性、按順序）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 小路改為 the same straight path；linear 改用來描述按順序的紀錄："he kept a linear record of every walk, listing the time and weather in order"，中譯同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 oval、pale、lazy 為低級字且與「橋很堅固」語意無關，一眼可排除；oval 在 u04-l07、u06-l03 也重複使用。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: q13 干擾項改為本課形容詞 slack、battered、elusive（「看起來不牢，其實很___」皆不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：q14 干擾項 ceaselessly 跨課重複，且三個干擾項只有一個放得進名詞空格
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 outset、respite（先前課名詞，放得進 lies in its ____ 但語意不通）與本課 startling

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：kept a linear record of every walk 搭配略少見（建議項）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "he recorded every walk in strict linear order, with the time and weather"，中譯同步

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：simplicity 例句「She always dresses with elegant simplicity.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「簡單、簡潔」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改寫為「The simplicity of the design makes the machine easy to use.」示範第一義；釋義為「簡單、簡潔；樸素」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：simplicity 是名詞，表示「簡單、簡潔」（例如 the simplicity of the design 等）／「很喜歡」可寫，例如 really like、love、like…a lot 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長 c1b2 裁示修正：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長 c1b2 裁示（第 1 批一併改）統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：elusive 表示「難以捉摸的、難以達到的」，位置有彈性（例如 remains elusive、an elusive goal 等）
